#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>

const int MOD = 998244353;

std::vector<int> convolute(const std::vector<int>& x, const std::vector<int>& y, int mod);
void fft(std::vector<double>& re, std::vector<double>& im, bool inverse);

int main() {
    int n, k;
    std::cin >> n >> k;

    std::vector<int> base(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int val;
        std::cin >> val;
        base[val] = 1;
    }

    std::vector<int> current = {1};
    int exponent = n / 2;

    while (exponent > 0) {
        if (exponent & 1) {
            current = convolute(current, base, MOD);
        }
        base = convolute(base, base, MOD);
        exponent >>= 1;
    }

    long long total = 0;
    for (int val : current) {
        total = (total + (long long)val * val) % MOD;
    }
    std::cout << total << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

std::vector<int> convolute(const std::vector<int>& x, const std::vector<int>& y, int mod) {
    int len = x.size() + y.size() - 1;
    int size = 1;
    while (size < len) size <<= 1;

    std::vector<double> xr(size, 0.0), xi(size, 0.0);
    std::vector<double> yr(size, 0.0), yi(size, 0.0);

    for (int i = 0; i < (int)x.size(); i++) {
        long long val = x[i] % mod;
        if (val < 0) val += mod;
        xr[i] = val & 0x7fffLL;
        xi[i] = val >> 15;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < (int)y.size(); i++) {
        long long val = y[i] % mod;
        if (val < 0) val += mod;
        yr[i] = val & 0x7fffLL;
        yi[i] = val >> 15;
    }

    fft(xr, xi, false);
    fft(yr, yi, false);

    std::vector<double> resR(size, 0.0), resI(size, 0.0);

    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        int j = (size - i) & (size - 1);
        double a1r = (xr[i] + xr[j]) * 0.5;
        double a1i = (xi[i] - xi[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2r = (xi[i] + xi[j]) * 0.5;
        double a2i = (xr[j] - xr[i]) * 0.5;

        double b1r = (yr[i] + yr[j]) * 0.5;
        double b1i = (yi[i] - yi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2r = (yi[i] + yi[j]) * 0.5;
        double b2i = (yr[j] - yr[i]) * 0.5;

        resR[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
        resI[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;
    }

    fft(resR, resI, true);

    std::vector<int> result(len, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
        long long val = std::llround(resR[i]);
        long long val2 = std::llround(resI[i]);
        long long combined = (val + (val2 << 15)) % mod;
        result[i] = static_cast<int>(combined);
    }
    return result;
}

void fft(std::vector<double>& re, std::vector<double>& im, bool inverse) {
    int n = re.size();
    if (n == 0) return;

    int bits = 0;
    int temp = n;
    while (temp > 1) {
        bits++;
        temp >>= 1;
    }

    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        int rev = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < bits; j++) {
            if (i & (1 << j)) {
                rev |= 1 << (bits - 1 - j);
            }
        }
        if (i < rev) {
            std::swap(re[i], re[rev]);
            std::swap(im[i], im[rev]);
        }
    }

    for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
        int half = len >> 1;
        double angle = 2 * M_PI / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
        double wlenR = std::cos(angle);
        double wlenI = std::sin(angle);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
            double wR = 1.0, wI = 0.0;
            for (int j = 0; j < half; j++) {
                double uR = re[i + j], uI = im[i + j];
                double vR = re[i + j + half] * wR - im[i + j + half] * wI;
                double vI = re[i + j + half] * wI + im[i + j + half] * wR;

                re[i + j] = uR + vR;
                im[i + j] = uI + vI;
                re[i + j + half] = uR - vR;
                im[i + j + half] = uI - vI;

                double tmp = wR * wlenR - wI * wlenI;
                wI = wR * wlenI + wI * wlenR;
                wR = tmp;
            }
        }
    }

    if (inverse) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            re[i] /= n;
            im[i] /= n;
        }
    }
}
